status_definitions.ACTIVE: Runtime counterfactual evidence shows a candidate-rank or selected-action effect; never inferred by this static audit alone.
status_definitions.REFERENCED_UNVERIFIED: A static reference and shallow return-value path exist, but runtime decision effect has not been verified.
status_definitions.UNUSED: Present in params.json but no supported parameter read was found in the audited agent source.
status_definitions.SHADOWED: Referenced, but an unconsumed scoring result prevents an observed decision effect.
status_definitions.DUPLICATE: Non-exclusive review flag for a possible duplicate concept.

decision_effect_definitions.STATICALLY_DECISION_RELEVANT: Shallow static return-use analysis found a possible path; this is not runtime proof.
decision_effect_definitions.NO_OBSERVED_DECISION_EFFECT: The enclosing scoring result is discarded or assigned without a later read.
decision_effect_definitions.NO_CODE_REFERENCE: No supported parameter read was found in the audited agent source; repository-wide tooling is outside this scan.
